editorial.assessment: STEP Bible is a UK charitable Bible-study project, not a church-management product. It is a useful no-cost option for individual study, group preparation and basic original-language exploration, particularly where a church does not need a paid digital library. Churches should check the permissions and scope of the specific Bible translations and study resources they intend to use publicly.

Leaders wanting searchable texts and original-language support without a subscription

limitations: It is not church-management, worship-presentation or licensed-song software
